description: This file defines a PHP class 'TranslationHelper' responsible for managing translation data within an HR system. It includes methods for adding translations from YAML files, interacting with a database via Doctrine DBAL, and handling language and translation records.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing translation records, loading from YAML files, and interacting with the database to store and retrieve translation-related data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Loads translation data from a YAML file in a specified directory and adds each translation to the database.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves a translation record into the database, handling creation and checks for existing translations.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the language ID from the database based on language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Fetches an existing translation record from the database based on language string ID and language ID.
